courses.title: Tarot Therapy: How to Use the Tarot for Healing & Development
courses.description: A self-paced online course taught with Steve Hounsome in seven lessons, each built around one of seven inner tarot mentors met through guided meditation. It uses the cards as a tool for reflection, personal growth and emotional healing, and comes with bonus material, a certificate and access to a monthly members' group on Zoom.

left_out: The Sleep Clinic (artoflivingwell.org.uk/p/the-sleep-clinic): the page's own description says it will 'cure insomnia', a cure claim for a medical condition under the new rule.

How to Stay Sane in an Insane World (£15, fees go to Doctors Without Borders): passes the new health rule, left out only because the listing already has 9 offerings and Tarot Therapy takes it to the 10 cap.
Trauma & Creativity (onlinevents.co.uk, with John Wilson): run by another organisation and the listing is at the 10-offering cap; not fetched.
Sacred Nature Healing Meditations: an audio album of four meditations with no ISBN on his page, so not a book.
flags: Tarot Therapy's page also offers instalments (3 x £69 or 3 x $93) and a one-time $276 USD; the plan uses the UK one-time price as shown (£205).
